settingsDescription: Reward customers for coming back. Points are worth money, so choose the numbers carefully.
enabledHelp: When off, no points are earned or used. Points customers already have are kept.
pointsPerUnitHelp: Only counted on money actually paid.
pointValueHelp: In taka, taken off a sale when the point is used.
expiryMonthsHelp: In months. Leave empty if points never end.
previewLine: Spend {spend} and get {points} points, worth {worth} off a later visit.
previewOff: No points are earned or used while this is off.
previewExpiry: Points end {months} months after they are earned.
